title: Armed Clashes in Ganthier (West Department) Displace 1,300+
detail: Armed clashes broke out on July 1, 2026 in the municipality of Ganthier, West Department, primarily affecting the Pinso and Grand-État localities of the 4th communal section of Mare Roseaux, near the Dominican Republic border corridor. The IOM Emergency Tracking Tool (ETT 99, covering July 1-7) documented approximately 1,328 people (262 households) displaced; all displaced persons found shelter with host families within Ganthier itself rather than fleeing to formal displacement sites. The incident adds to a pattern of gang violence spreading along Route Nationale 8 toward the eastern border region, an area with negligible GSF or PNH coverage.

media.caption: Haiti's displacement crisis continues to deepen amid gang violence
